v2_human_g3_constraints.c_1: Meetings may only start within working hours
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_2: Candidate start times are every 15 minutes
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_3: No meeting may start during lunch (12:00-13:00)
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_4: A candidate time is rejected if it overlaps with any current event
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_5: Back to back meetings are treated as conflicts
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_6: Meetings can not be scheduled v2_human 15:00 on Fridays

v2_human_g3_exception: Friday meetings can't be scheduled v2_human 15:00, but it's fine on other days. Meetings can not be scheduled on Sat and Sun

v2_human_g3_fr.fr_1: Should find all the timeslots that would for the meeting
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_3: Should not return meeting times that are v2_human 15:00 on Fridays

v2_human_g3_goal: It aims to suggest a list of valid meeting times on a given day subject to some constraints.
v2_human_g3_input: events: List of 2-tuples dicts in python) with the start time and ending time of the meeting, meeting_duration: Duration of meeting in minutes, day: string indicating the day it should be scheduled on.

v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_1: Meetings are not scheduled v2_human 15:00 on Fridays
v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_2: Meeting start times 9:00 can not be suggested

v2_human_g3_output: List of strings that contain valid starting time of the meeting we want to schedule on the given day.
v2_human_g3_tb: Candidate time slots are generated in ascending order. A slot that starts exactly when the event ends is treated as a conflict

v2_humang3_invariants.inv_1: Meeting days are not Sat or Sun
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_2: List of meetings should not have overlapping events
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_3: List of meetings can not have meetings on Fridays that start v2_human 15:00
